description: NaScGe₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.57 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.23 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.80 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ge atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSc₂Ge tetrahedra.
